_comment: EC2 Runtime IAM Policy — CloudAWSProject-101
This policy grants the EC2 backend role the minimum S3 permissions
required to operate the application at runtime.
BEFORE APPLYING: replace YOUR-BUCKET-NAME with the actual S3 bucket name.
Example: arn:aws:s3:::my-sync-bucket
Permissions audit:
s3:PutObject       — upload file content (POST /sync/upload -> S3FileStorage.put)
s3:GetObject       — download file content (future M7 cloud->local sync)
s3:DeleteObject    — place delete marker (POST /sync/delete -> S3FileStorage.delete)
s3:ListBucket      — required for head_object 404 disambiguation on some SDK versions.
Permissions intentionally EXCLUDED from runtime policy:
s3:PutBucketVersioning — setup-only, run once by an admin via backend/s3_setup.py.
Not a runtime application operation.
s3:GetBucketVersioning — not called anywhere in the runtime application code.
s3:CreateBucket        — buckets are created in AWS Console, never by the app.
s3:DeleteBucket        — must never be available to the runtime role.
s3:*                   — broad wildcard; never use.
This policy does NOT grant RDS access.  RDS connectivity is controlled by
the RDS security group (PostgreSQL from EC2 security group only).
Attach this policy to the IAM Role used as the EC2 instance profile.
See modules/module-06/README.md for the full AWS Console deployment steps.
